CREATE TABLE memory_situation_manifests (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	call_identity VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	content_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_situation_manifest_call UNIQUE (scope_setting_id, call_identity), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)


CREATE TABLE memory_situation_runs (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	"trigger" VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	request_identity VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	cutoff_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cursor INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	settings_snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_until DATETIME, 
	applied_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	skipped_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	blocked_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_situation_run_identity UNIQUE (scope_setting_id, "trigger", request_identity), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_situation_run_trigger CHECK (trigger IN ('scheduled','manual','quit')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_situation_run_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','running','completed','deferred','error'))
)

CREATE INDEX ix_situation_run_pending ON memory_situation_runs (state, created_at)

CREATE TABLE memory_situation_settings (
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	daily_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	local_time VARCHAR(5) DEFAULT '22:30' NOT NULL, 
	timezone VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	shutdown_apply_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	next_due_at DATETIME, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	last_request_key VARCHAR(128), 
	last_request_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	last_applied_at DATETIME, 
	brief_dirty BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_setting_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_situation_setting_version CHECK (version >= 1)
)


CREATE TABLE memory_situation_transitions (
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	admitted_after DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	legacy_cutoff INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	discard_key VARCHAR(128), 
	discarded_job_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	discarded_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_setting_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)


CREATE TABLE memory_situation_receipts (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, 
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	logical_activity_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	lane VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	target_key VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	activation_epoch VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	description_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	captured_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	run_id VARCHAR(64), 
	applied_item_id VARCHAR(64), 
	applied_at DATETIME, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_situation_receipt_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','claimed','applied','blocked','skipped','error')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(manifest_id) REFERENCES memory_situation_manifests (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(applied_item_id) REFERENCES memory_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES memory_situation_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_situation_activity_target UNIQUE (scope_setting_id, logical_activity_id, lane, target_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_situation_lane CHECK (lane IN ('chat','inbox','feed','routine')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_situation_description_status CHECK (description_status IN ('valid','missing','invalid','output_order_invalid'))
)

CREATE INDEX ix_situation_receipt_pending ON memory_situation_receipts (scope_setting_id, state, sequence)

CREATE TABLE memory_situation_requests (
	scope_setting_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	request_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(64), 
	result_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_setting_id, request_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_setting_id) REFERENCES memory_scope_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES memory_situation_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)


CREATE TABLE memory_situation_info (
	memory_item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	receipt_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	locale VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	thought_reference VARCHAR(128), 
	PRIMARY KEY (memory_item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(receipt_sequence) REFERENCES memory_situation_receipts (sequence) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(memory_item_id) REFERENCES memory_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE INDEX ix_memory_situation_info_receipt_sequence ON memory_situation_info (receipt_sequence)

CREATE TABLE memory_situation_sources (
	memory_item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	evidence_id VARCHAR(64), 
	source JSON NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (memory_item_id, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(evidence_id) REFERENCES memory_item_evidence (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(memory_item_id) REFERENCES memory_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
